lead: High-tech photograph, glossy white lab, graphite and steel, lime-green neon accents.

images.name: frame
images.prompt: An experimental armored android frame standing in a test bay, engineers around it

images.name: arena
images.prompt: Remote-operated robots fighting on a makeshift stage full of hazards, a crowd watching

images.name: bout
images.prompt: Two robots on floating platforms trading shots, a spark of impact between them

images.name: gauntlet
images.prompt: A row of arena stages lit one after another, a huge champion robot waiting at the end

images.name: workshop
images.prompt: A workshop wall of robot parts, guns and paint, a robot on a workbench being customized

images.name: break
images.prompt: A robot sitting on a crate between fights, a cup of coffee on a console nearby

images.name: loadout
images.prompt: A rack of rifles, swords and hammers next to robot leg and arm modules

images.name: ammo
images.prompt: A glowing ammo crate on an arena floor, spent guns scattered around it

images.name: pace
images.prompt: A robot floating gently in mid-air above a platform, a slow glowing projectile passing by

images.name: crates
images.prompt: Reinforced crates, barrels and glass panes stacked as cover on a bright stage
